title: WHAT IF YOU OPENED A
BURGER JOINT IN ROME?

youtube.title: What If You Opened a McDonald's in Ancient Rome?
tags: what if you opened a mcdonalds in ancient rome
youtube.intro: You and your little sister wake up in Rome, in the summer of AD 64, with one cold burger in a paper bag. So you open the first burger restaurant on Earth. The crowds love it. The other cooks hate it. And the emperor's palace wants it. But something about Rome in July of 64 should sound very familiar.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you have signed the contract to get Ellie back? 👇

And be honest: did your grill start the Great Fire of Rome, or did someone set you up? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The history checks out: about 80 street food counters found in Pompeii, a meat patty in a real Roman cookbook (isicia omentata), Nero's ban on hot food in taverns, and the fire that started by the Circus Maximus on 18 July AD 64. Sources are in the description.
